evidence.curator_note: Book draws 2 arc(s) on the first (leftmost) structure; moves <1,2> are drawn, move <3> is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Drawn arc 1 = a fishhook from the odd electron of the n-ionized oxygen (the printed '+.' sits on O, the C=O double bond drawn intact) into the C(1)-O(2) bond; drawn arc 2 = a fishhook from the ring C(1)-C(3) sigma bond into that same C-O bond, which therefore rises from double to triple (acylium). The undrawn move 3 carries the second electron of the cleaved C(1)-C(3) bond onto C(3); the book instead simply prints the resulting radical dot on that carbon in the next structure. Because the carbonyl carbon is IN the four-membered ring, this alpha cleavage only OPENS the ring - no mass is lost yet - giving the distonic acylium/alkyl-radical ion .CH2CH2CH2-C(triple bond)O+. The precursor mapped_smiles localizes charge and odd electron on oxygen exactly as printed. Map numbers: 1 = carbonyl C, 2 = O, 3 = the alpha carbon that is cleaved off C1 (bears R2, drawn at the left of the diamond), 4 = the CH2 between the two alpha carbons (bottom of the diamond), 5 = the alpha carbon retained by the acyl group (right of the diamond).

Book draws 2 arc(s) on the second (ring-opened) structure; moves <1,2> are drawn, move <3> is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Drawn arc 1 = a fishhook from the radical dot on C(3) into the forming C(3)=C(4) pi bond; drawn arc 2 = a fishhook from the C(4)-C(5) sigma bond into that same forming pi bond. The undrawn move 3 carries the second electron of C(4)-C(5) onto C(5) - the book prints that radical as the dot next to 'R2' in the drawn product. Net result of this second alpha cleavage (the page labels both arrows 'alpha'): loss of the neutral olefin R2C=CH2 (here ethene, m/z 28, not printed) and retention of the charge on the acyl fragment.

Book draws 0 arc(s) here: it prints a double-headed resonance arrow linking the drawn product .R2C-C(triple bond)O+ with the ionized-ketene form R2C=C=O(+.) (the '+.' printed on the oxygen, R and R on the terminal carbon). All three encoded moves are curator-supplied bookkeeping for that resonance interconversion (radical electron of C5 into the C1-C5 bond, one electron of the C1-O triple bond into the same bond, the other back onto O). Convention (C): the fragmentation steps above are written to the LOCALIZED acylium/alkyl-radical form the book draws first, and this step converts it to the ketene form the book draws second; the two are one and the same ion, so only the ketene form is flagged detected.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for equation 8.58 - no MOD Rule.fromDFS encodes this cyclobutanone double-alpha-cleavage, so no cross-link is asserted. The nearest indexed generic carbonyl alpha-cleavage rule, IMS_4_14 (DFS '[C]1([C]2[C]3)([C]4[C]5){=}[O+.]>>[C.]2[C]3.[C]4[C]5[C]1{#}[O+]'), was CHECKED against this substrate and does NOT apply, on two counts. (i) Its left pattern needs two distinct 2-carbon branches on the carbonyl carbon; in cyclobutanone both alpha carbons share the SAME beta carbon, so an injective match is impossible - verified with RDKit, SMARTS [#6](-[#6]-[#6])(-[#6]-[#6])=[O+] gives 0 matches on [C:1]1(=[O+:2])[CH2:3][CH2:4][CH2:5]1. (ii) Independently, IMS_4_14 is MIS-ENCODED: loading it in MOD gives left edges (C1-C2, C1-C4, C1=O) and right edges (C1-C5, C1#O), i.e. it breaks BOTH bonds to the carbonyl carbon and bonds the acylium to C5 (the terminal carbon of the retained chain) rather than to C4, a skeletal rearrangement that also over-fills C5's valence. This is a corpus-level finding beyond the present page (the existing IMS4-EQ4.14 record's note asserts the acylium 'retains the other' ethyl unchanged, which the GML does not support). ms_context: the page prints no electron energy; the scheme sits in ordinary EI-spectrum discussion (Figure 8.4 on the same page is an EI mass spectrum) and the book's spectra are the standard 70 eV EI, so EI/70 eV/[M]+. is used. precursor_mz 70.0413 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of the cyclobutanone molecular ion for the printed R = H instantiation, not a number printed on the page.

The page prints, directly under the scheme, 'R = H : m/z 42, 100%'. relative_intensity 1.0 is that printed base-peak percentage; observed_mz 42.0100 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of the C2H2O(+.) ketene radical cation, consistent with the printed nominal 42.
